## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # 2D scenes
//
// Retained scene description for 2D vector graphics: a flat node array forms
// a tree via parent indices, and node content (styled paths, text layouts,
// image references) lives in parallel pools addressed by index. Viewport and
// export settings close the file. BlendMode is owned by
// `image-processing.types.plato`.

// The content a scene node carries. None is a pure transform node; Group has
// children only and is composited as an isolation group. The indexed cases
// address the owning scene's parallel pools (Shapes, Texts, ImageReferences).
type NodeContent2D
    = None
    | Shape(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Text(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Image(Index: ItemIndex)
    | Group;

// A zero-based index of a node within Scene2D's flat node array. -1 means
// "none" (a root's parent, a hit-test miss).
type SceneNodeIndex2D
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}

// One node of a 2D scene, stored in Scene2D's flat node array. Parent is the
// index of the parent node, -1 for a root. Transform places the node
// relative to its parent; Opacity and Blend composite the node's rendered
// output over what lies beneath. Content selects and addresses the node's
// payload in the owning scene's pools. ClipIndex selects a clip mask from
// the scene's clip pool, -1 for none.
type SceneNode2D
    implements IValue
{
    Name: String;
    Parent: SceneNodeIndex2D;
    Transform: TrsTransform2D;
    Opacity: Proportion;
    Blend: BlendMode;
    Visible: Boolean;
    Content: NodeContent2D;
    ClipIndex: ItemIndex;
}

// Where a clip/mask draws its coverage from. Path coverage is the geometric
// interior of a path under the path's own fill rule. Alpha and Luminance take
// coverage from the rendered output of the scene node at the given index.
type MaskSource2D
    implements IValue
    = Path(Path: Path2D)                    // interior of a path under its own fill rule
    | Alpha(SourceNode: SceneNodeIndex2D)       // alpha channel of the rendered node at this index
    | Luminance(SourceNode: SceneNodeIndex2D);  // luminance of the rendered node at this index

// A clipping or masking region applied to a scene node and its subtree.
// Inverted swaps inside and outside.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clipping_path)
type ClipMask2D
    implements IValue
{
    Source: MaskSource2D;
    Inverted: Boolean;
}

// A complete 2D scene: the parent-indexed node array plus the content pools
// nodes address by index. ImageReferences holds opaque integer handles into
// an external image/texture table owned by the host asset system; a node
// with IImage content stores an index into this array.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scene_graph)
type Scene2D
    implements IValue
{
    Nodes: Array<SceneNode2D>;
    Shapes: Array<StyledPath2D>;
    Texts: Array<TextLayout>;
    ImageReferences: Array<Integer>;
    Clips: Array<ClipMask2D>;
}

// A mapping from scene coordinates to device pixels: the rectangular region
// of the scene that is visible, and the pixel dimensions of the target it
// maps onto. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viewport)
type Viewport2D
    implements IValue
{
    View: Bounds2D;
    PixelSize: IntegerSize2D;
}

// Settings for exporting a scene to a raster or document format.
// DotsPerInch scales document units to physical output; Background is
// composited beneath the scene (zero alpha for transparent output).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dots_per_inch)
type ExportSettings2D
    implements IValue
{
    DotsPerInch: Number;
    Background: Color;
}

// The result of hit-testing a point against a scene: the index of the
// topmost node hit (-1 for a miss) and the hit position in that node's local
// space. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit-testing)
type SceneHitResult2D
    implements IValue
{
    Node: SceneNodeIndex2D;
    LocalPosition: Point2D;
}
```
